title: Zlatko's Quantum Notebook: talks, lectures and technical notes by Zlatko K. Minev
description: Slides and technical notes by Zlatko K. Minev, 2011 to present: research talks, summer-school lectures, tutorials and derivations on superconducting qubits and circuit QED, quantum noise, error mitigation and many-body physics. Browse and cite individual decks at https://zlatko-minev.github.io/zlatko-minev-quantum-repository/.
